Immaculate Gothic family package 1.101
Created 5 October 2026

Original AI-assisted custom type design for the requesting user.

The letterforms began as independently constructed outlines for this project. The user selected the slightly heavier Text450 direction. The Text release extended that approved design into a bounded Latin face. This family package adds the requested Bold700 through real outline expansion, independent optical corrections, rebuilt composites, new hinting and weight-specific spacing. No external font files or proprietary font outlines were used as source material.

General visual direction referenced contemporary grotesk typography, including the Cursor Gothic feel requested by the user. Immaculate Gothic is an independent typeface and is not affiliated with Cursor or Kimera.

Engineering tools included FontTools, Skia PathOps, HarfBuzz, ttfautohint and Brotli. Hinting is automatic, not hand-tuned. These tools were used for construction, shaping, validation or compression; their application code is not bundled here.

No open-source licence has been imposed on the user's font. This note records provenance and scope; it is not a trademark search, legal clearance, warranty or restriction on the user's choice of licensing for onward distribution.

The supplied upright Text450 and Bold700 faces are included. Read README.md for exact coverage and tested/unverified environments.

Family renamed to Immaculate Gothic at the user’s request. This update changes naming only; glyph outlines, spacing, features and metrics are unchanged.
